from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689779/attempts/75b9ca6211d4403aafd75899a9af5d34/system/state/workspace/programs'); root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
grid=[[8]*14 for _ in range(18)]
grid[2][4]=3;grid[7][3]=3;grid[9][8]=3;grid[11][2]=3;grid[16][3]=3;grid[16][9]=3
patch=[[8,8,8,1,7],[8,1,0,0,1],[7,0,1,1,7]]
# preserve patch source at (2,8) then repeat anchor center
for r in range(3):
 for c in range(5): grid[2+r][8+c]=patch[r][c]
def transform(g):
 out=[row[:] for row in g]
 # identify stamp region by non-background/non-marker: source template concept; use known 1,0,7 cells bounding box
 pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v in (0,1,7)]
 r0=min(r for r,c in pts);r1=max(r for r,c in pts);c0=min(c for r,c in pts);c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
 stamp=[[g[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
 # anchor center based bbox midpoint, source demo line stamp uses middle index. 
 ar=(r1-r0)//2; ac=(c1-c0)//2
 for r,row in enumerate(g):
  for c,v in enumerate(row):
   if v==3:
    for i,srow in enumerate(stamp):
     for j,x in enumerate(srow):
      rr=r+i-ar; cc=c+j-ac
      if 0<=rr<len(out) and 0<=cc<len(out[0]) and x!=8: out[rr][cc]=x
 return out
# save
src='''def transform(g):\n    out=[row[:] for row in g]\n    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v in (0,1,7)]\n    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)\n    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)\n    stamp=[[g[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]\n    ar=(r1-r0)//2; ac=(c1-c0)//2\n    for r,row in enumerate(g):\n        for c,v in enumerate(row):\n            if v==3:\n                for i,srow in enumerate(stamp):\n                    for j,x in enumerate(srow):\n                        rr=r+i-ar; cc=c+j-ac\n                        if 0<=rr<len(out) and 0<=cc<len(out[0]) and x!=8: out[rr][cc]=x\n    return out\n'''
# issue output source patterns get updated when locating markers iteration but original g untouched fine
(root/'task-13a92725.py').write_text(src)
res=transform(grid)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in res))
